name: @pipeworx/mcp-cftc-cot

tools.name: search_markets
tools.description: Find CFTC Commitment of Traders (COT) futures markets by name. Use this first to get the exact market_and_exchange_names and contract_code that latest_report and report_history require. Keyless. e.g. "crude oil", "gold", "E-MINI S&P", "bitcoin", "euro", "corn".

query.description: Substring to match against the market name, e.g. "crude oil", "gold", "E-MINI S&P", "bitcoin", "euro".

limit.description: Max distinct markets to return (default 15, max 30).

tools.name: latest_report
tools.description: Most recent weekly COT positioning for one futures market. Pass the exact market_and_exchange_names from search_markets, e.g. "CRUDE OIL, LIGHT SWEET-WTI - NEW YORK MERCANTILE EXCHANGE" or "GOLD - COMMODITY EXCHANGE INC.". Returns open interest plus long/short/net for non-commercial (≈ speculators: managed money / large traders), commercial (≈ hedgers / producers), and non-reportable (small traders), with this week's changes. Keyless.

market_name.description: Exact market_and_exchange_names from search_markets, e.g. "CRUDE OIL, LIGHT SWEET-WTI - NEW YORK MERCANTILE EXCHANGE".

tools.name: report_history
tools.description: Weekly net-position time series for one futures market (non-commercial net, commercial net, open interest), most recent first. Pass the exact market_and_exchange_names from search_markets. Useful for trend / sentiment shifts over time. Keyless.

weeks.description: Number of weekly reports to return (default 26, max 104).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-cftc-cot forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the cftc-cot pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
